verdicts.name: Lift
verdicts.bar: on the held-out block, cold, one try each: the distilled model is right on at least 5 points in a hundred more than the base, it solves more of the problems the base failed than it loses of the ones the base solved, and the difference is significant (exact two-sided McNemar test, p < 0.05)

verdicts.name: Still honest
verdicts.bar: on the same block the distilled model gives no more confident wrong answers than the base
verdicts.result: confident wrong answers: base 113 of 229, distilled 113 of 229; no answer: base 0, distilled 0

verdicts.name: The fail-wall moved
verdicts.bar: more held-out problems go from failed (base) to solved (distilled) than the other way
verdicts.result: 12 held-out problems the base failed are solved by the distilled model; 12 the base solved are lost

verdicts.name: Verify-or-dissolve at the weights
verdicts.bar: the outcome published for the round is the one the rule gives (adopted only if K1 and K2 both pass, dissolved otherwise), and the round stands only on weights adopted by the rule and granted by a person
verdicts.result: the rule gives: DISSOLVE (the cold lift did not clear its bar); published: dissolved; it stands on the weights of 1 earlier round, each adopted and granted

verdicts.name: Clean training data
verdicts.bar: every training example is a complete crystal's verified working, checked again by exact arithmetic; none is unverified; the trainer read that file, byte for byte
verdicts.result: 539 of 539 training examples verified by exact arithmetic, 0 unverified; the trainer read that file, byte for byte

verdicts.name: Held-out integrity
verdicts.bar: no held-out problem is in the training set, and no held-out problem was harvested
verdicts.result: 0 of 229 held-out problems are in the training set; 0 were harvested

why: the cold lift did not clear its bar
